description: Returns statutory Icelandic public holidays, half-day holidays (Christmas Eve & New Year's Eve from 13:00), and official flag days (fánadagar) calculated deterministically per Stjórnarráð Íslands & Alþingi acts.

include_flag_days.description: Include non-holiday official flag days such as Sjómannadagurinn and Nov 16 (default true).

include_half_days.description: Include Dec 24 & Dec 31 half-day holidays from 13:00 (default true).

year.description: Target year (defaults to current year in Atlantic/Reykjavik).

name: get_public_holidays
title: Get Icelandic Public Holidays & Flag Days
